caption: The drawing depicts a carved statue of a standing male figure dressed in Native American attire. The figure wears a long reddish-brown tunic with fringe details and matching leggings. Over his left shoulder, he has a light brown sash or blanket draped. On his head is a detailed headdress consisting of multicolored feathers in green, yellow, and red, attached to a tan band. Around his neck, he wears several necklaces in beige and dark tones. His right hand holds a black bag with a strap, and his left hand is extended with the palm facing slightly upward. Leaning against his body and resting on a rectangular dark base is a long rifle, colored in brown with metallic details. The statue stands on a raised, textured surface that resembles stone or earth. The background is a plain, light beige color, and the artist's name "FLORIAN ROKITA" is written in small block letters in the lower right corner.
title: Cigar Store Indian
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
